entities.summary: Eugène Albertini was a 20th-century French teacher in Latin literature, a historian of ancient Rome, especially for North Africa and an epigrapher of Latin texts. He was a member of the Académie des inscriptions et belles-lettres (1938).

entities.summary: Eugène Albertini was a 20th-century French teacher in Latin literature, a historian of ancient Rome, especially for North Africa and an epigrapher of Latin texts. He was a member of the Académie des inscriptions et belles-lettres (1938).
